The one genuine signal was Oklo's Pike County site build-out tied to a Meta data-center power deal, a real hyperscaler-PPA nuclear catalyst consistent with the profile's SMR thesis, but it argues for a second nuclear name alongside SMR, not a replacement for any current holding, and this week's constraint requires a paired removal for any add. Nothing in the pool constitutes a fundamental thesis breach or an unpriced peak-enthusiasm signal for GOOGL, NVDA, RKLB, or SMR (the NUKZ ETF surge/concentration-risk piece is a basket-level note, not SMR-specific), so no current holding clears the bar for removal. Watchlist unchanged; Oklo (OKLO) is now on the radar for a future rebalance if its nuclear/data-center catalyst persists alongside a clearer case to trim an existing name.
